title: Japanese Ehomaki Caramel Hazelnut Kissed
description: A unique dessert that combines Japanese flavors with caramel and hazelnuts.
instructions: Cut the Japanese Ehomaki into 1-inch squares.
Place the squares on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the caramel sauce over the Ehomaki squares.
Sprinkle chopped hazelnuts over the caramel.
Bake for 5-7 minutes or until the caramel is bubbly and the hazelnuts are toasted.
Remove from oven and let cool for 1-2 minutes.
Drizzle melted kissed chocolate chips over the top of the Ehomaki.
